Created the Rust port in [test2.rs](/output/test2.rs) with shared modules in [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml), [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), [src/atoi.rs](/output/src/atoi.rs), [src/polygon.rs](/output/src/polygon.rs), [src/render.rs](/output/src/render.rs), and [src/triangulation.rs](/output/src/triangulation.rs). It uses only `std`, parses CLI input through `std::env::args()`, emulates the observed `atoi` behavior, and writes stdout byte-for-byte like the C++ program, including trailing spaces and no newline.

The executable was built at `/output/test2`, and `cargo build --release` also produced `target/release/test2`. Verification passed with `cargo test`, `cargo build --release`, and `rustc --edition=2021 test2.rs -o test2`; the Rust binary matched `/workspace/dataset/test2_executable` for no-arg, normal, invalid, signed, fractional-text, and overflow cases.
